text:
Anna (Support): FYI — GreenArc reported two invoices and two charges for their monthly renewal today. Customer is upset; we need a quick reversal and root-cause. Invoice IDs: inv_9Xb2R and inv_9Xb2S. Both posted ~1975301200. Charged via card and also via PO. :frown:
Elena (CSM): Ugh. They attached a PO yesterday afternoon and said they'd keep auto-renew enabled. They saw two merchant charges on their finance team. Customer wants refund ASAP and confirmation we won't retry. I'll handle comms if you confirm next steps. :pray:
Raj (Billing): Can you paste the payment instrument IDs and any webhook/request IDs? We'll need to create credit notes and route the refund through finance if amounts > $5k. Also need to know if revenue was recognized.
Anna (Support): Copying logs and the webhook payloads below. Looks like a race: user attached PO (pm_po_77) at 1975299900 via UI, and our scheduled renewal job ran at 1975301205 and created invoice inv_9Xb2R (card) then within 3s our PO-attach flow created inv_9Xb2S (PO). Webhook retries from Stripe also show two invoice.paid events.
Anna (Support): ```
POST /api/payments/attach
body: {"customer":"cus_GreenArc","pm":"pm_po_77","source":"upload-po"}
resp: 200 idempotency: attach:1975299900

Scheduled job: POST /jobs/renewals/run
payload: {"sub":"sub_GA_01","timestamp":1975301205}
created invoice: inv_9Xb2R -> payment_method pm_card_22 -> paid

Stripe events:
- invoice.paid id: evt_1Aaa t:1975301210 (for inv_9Xb2R)
- invoice.paid id: evt_1Aab t:1975301213 (for inv_9Xb2S)
```
Morgan (Payments Eng): Thanks — this looks like a classic attach-vs-renew race. The PO attach flow creates a new invoice when attaching a payment instrument if the subscription is due; our scheduled renewals job doesn't check for concurrent attach transactions. The idempotency keys differ (attach uses "attach:1975299900", renewals job uses job-run IDs) so Stripe and our internal invoicer treat them as separate intents.
Morgan (Payments Eng): Quick repro steps I ran locally:
1) Create subscription with card on file (pm_card_22) with renew_at soon.
2) Submit attach PO request (pm_po_77) with idempotency header X-Idemp: attach-<ts> concurrently with run-renewal job -> two invoices.
Result: two invoice rows, two invoice.paid events.
Morgan (Payments Eng): Root cause: no global locking on subscription invoice creation + reliance on external idempotency. Mitigation path:
- Immediate: mark customer subscription as auto_renew_disabled for GreenArc, manually refund the duplicate charge (refund the later invoice inv_9Xb2S charged to PO or inv_9Xb2R depending on card reconciliation) and issue a credit note. I recommend refund the smaller one if amounts differ, but confirm with finance.
- Short-term patch: make the renewals job check for a pending invoice/ongoing attach operation with a single DB transaction (SELECT FOR UPDATE on subscription row) before creating invoice.
- Long-term: unify idempotency semantics across attach & renew flows (shared idempotency key derived from subscription+period).
Raj (Billing): Amounts: inv_9Xb2R = $6,750.00 (card), inv_9Xb2S = $6,750.00 (PO). Total = $13,500. Finance ok to process refund for the second charge but needs flag in ticket to reverse revenue. I'll create a finance ticket and mark as high priority. 
Raj (Billing): Action items for support: confirm which charge hit the customer's bank (card vs PO/AR). Elena, can you confirm if GreenArc provided a PO number so we can attribute to AR team?
Elena (CSM): They provided PO# GA-2026-77 and attached PDF. They say their AP team shows the card charge and the PO invoice both settled in their system. They prefer refund to card and credit PO. I'll confirm with them which payment they want refunded first and update here. :phone:
Anna (Support): I initiated a manual refund request to Stripe for inv_9Xb2R (card charge) to minimize immediate card-facing incident — request id rf_22Z. Waiting for confirmation. StripeWebhookBot: refund.succeeded rf_22Z delivered at 1975303000.
StripeWebhookBot: Webhook: {"type":"charge.refunded","data":{"object":{"id":"ch_88a","invoice":"inv_9Xb2R","amount_refunded":675000}}}
Raj (Billing): Great. After refund, we need to issue a credit note for inv_9Xb2S and mark the invoice as reversed in revenue system. I'll open the credit note and attach the refund proof. Tagging finance: @raj FYI.
Morgan (Payments Eng): I'll open a small PR to add a SELECT FOR UPDATE lock in renewals job and block concurrent attach flows. ETA: 4 hrs for hotfix, then deploy to staging. Post-deploy I'll run the repro script and confirm no double-invoice. Will also add metrics: duplicate_invoices_count by subscription.
Anna (Support): Customer has been informed we refunded the card and will credit the PO invoice. CSM will send a formal apology and CLAIR note. Elena will confirm once AP reconciles. :white_check_mark:
Elena (CSM): I'll confirm with the customer by EOD and share the finance ticket number. Thanks all. 
Morgan (Payments Eng): I'll follow up in prod after hotfix deploy, and post logs here.
Anna (Support): Closing loop here once finance confirms credit note and revenue reversal. Thanks team. :pray:
